sites._source: user decision 2026-10-08 (mixed cut, JOURNAL 14:32 ff.): depth-2 nodes (top > 2nd level) with >= 4,500 questions of single-path products; a node whose depth-3 children include >= 2 nodes meeting the same bar is replaced by those children (the parent's other products are dropped). Products with more than one category path are excluded (1.5%). Site category = top-level node (analogue of the SE category).

split._source: D1 (user '진행해' 2026-10-08, recommended option): SE sizes (A0 test 1,000 / cal 500 / bank 3,000); product-level split (query products and bank products disjoint); at most 5 questions per query product (our choice: within-product clustering). Sites that cannot fill the sizes after deduplication are dropped and listed.

dedup._source: user decision 2026-10-08: within a site, keep the first question per normalised question text (lower case, punctuation stripped, whitespace collapsed; A0 used lower case + whitespace only). Across sites (review 2026-10-08, user '수정해서 진행해'; replaces the earlier test-informed rule): every normalised question that occurs in two or more candidate sites is removed from all sites before the query / bank split, so no query text can occur in any bank or as another site's query and no bank is curated with test queries.

text._source: D2 (user 2026-10-08, recommended): query = question; bank document = question + ' ' + answer; the product title is not used. Questions with an empty question or answer are dropped before deduplication (queries too; our choice, keeps one candidate pool for both roles).

distance._source: D3 (user 2026-10-08, recommended): co-purchase profile of a site = distribution over depth-3 category nodes (paths shorter than 3: the full path) of the also_bought targets of the site's non-query products (targets mapped through all 17 metadata files; a target with several paths spreads unit weight equally over its distinct nodes; unmapped targets dropped and counted); Jensen-Shannon distance sqrt(JSD), log base 2 (as A0 tag-JS). Bands: the same quantile levels as A0 (q10 neighbour, q50 far) over all site pairs. KB neighbour band for the A1 slot rules (review 2026-10-08, user): primary = d <= q10 without the category condition (36% of q10 pairs cross top-level nodes, so the A1 same-category condition would leave strong KB neighbours in the N slots); sensitivity = the A1 rule (same top-level node and d <= q10). Tree distance (sensitivity): 1 = same depth-2 parent (siblings from a split), 2 = same top-level node, 3 = different top-level node. Profiles are summed in sorted order (bit-stable). Diagnostic (review 2026-10-08): the same JS with unmapped targets kept as one pseudo-node (copurchase_js_unmapped.csv), compared by rank agreement only.
